authority: preregistered response-blind immutable state-library interface census
scientific_question: Within the same immutable 16-node state library, do any states with matched total profile water and matched upper-30-cm water retain a materially different pressure head at the bottom SWAP node adjacent to the fixed groundwater interface?
rationale: E03D found 59 pairs satisfying both storage controls but no materially separated deep centroid.
A direct response census over tolerance-matched aggregates would be ambiguous because any small response difference could still be caused by the residual storage mismatch.
Bottom-node pressure head is mechanistically closer to fixed-Hc exchange than a whole-deep-profile centroid because it directly contributes to the near-interface hydraulic gradient.
A state-only interface census therefore provides a sharper prerequisite for the next response probe.

source_authority.source_artifacts: exact five immutable D04/E01/E03/E03B/E03C artifacts frozen by E03D
source_authority.state_input: node-level committed H/theta plus provenance only

frozen_pair_gate.distinct_state_requirement: different immutable provenance and non-bit-identical H/theta vectors

threshold_basis: 0.01 cm is fixed prospectively and is ten orders of magnitude above the 1e-12 cm head convergence tolerance used by the carrier.
The threshold is a state-separation screen, not a response-effect threshold.

selection.candidate_pool: same deduplicated immutable state union as E03D
selection.pair_scope: all distinct pairs passing both storage controls
ranking: largest abs(delta theta16) as diagnostic tie-breaker
selection.no_match: Close E03E NO_MATCH without changing source set, storage tolerances or the 0.01 cm H16 threshold.

response_firewall: no fixed-Hc response, exchange, terminal flux or tangent information may be parsed
selected pair, if any, must be persisted with all 16 H/theta values before E04
no response threshold is defined or inspected in E03E
next_if_selected: GC-RZM06E04 common-time reconstruction and the frozen E02 fixed-Hc probe applied to the immutable E03E pair, with both storage controls rechecked before response.
nonclaims: H16 is not proposed as a production reduced-state variable.
Selection alone does not establish response causality.
A NO_MATCH would be evidence about the attained state library only, not a universal hydraulic identity.
